## Hot fix for 0.2.13:

### New Features

- **Yandex Music as a source** - Sign in by device code or QR, and the account's liked artists, albums and playlists show up in the sidebar next to the rest. Album, artist and playlist pages, paged search, playback, covers and offline downloads all go through the media server like Navidrome does; the session is kept app-private and the settings section carries the unofficial-API disclaimer and an enable switch
- **My Wave** - Yandex stations run as a queue mode: starting the wave replaces the queue, tops itself up two tracks before the tail, and reports starts, finishes and skips back to Yandex so the chain actually adapts. It ends the moment you queue something by hand, play a collection or clear the queue. The wave sits as a system row leading the Yandex catalog in the sidebar - one click, no page, no menu
- **Likes reach the account** - The heart on a Yandex track, artist, album or playlist is sent to Yandex and comes back on the next launch, from the player and from catalog rows that were never in the library; own playlists can be deleted at Yandex from the page menu. A like the server refuses changes nothing locally
- **YouTube without the sidecar** - Innertube now runs in the webview (youtubei.js) instead of the bundled yt-dlp and rustypipe binary. Search, browse, details, playback, prefetch and downloads work on every target, Android included, and there is nothing to keep updated in the background anymore - when YouTube changes, the app updates

### Improvements

- **A download is now a real local track** - A finished YouTube or Navidrome download is imported as a file with a reference back to the catalog row, tagged from the catalog rather than from what the container happens to carry. Remote ids resolve to that local copy, so the track plays offline, appears in search and lists like any other file, and stops living as a pinned remote row. Existing offline copies are migrated once on upgrade; a copy that fails to import keeps its file
- **Full-speed YouTube streaming** - googlevideo throttles unranged and open-ended requests to around 30 KB/s, so the route, prefetch and downloads walk the file in bounded 10 MiB ranges instead
- YouTube player scripts are evaluated in a dedicated worker with no IPC and no DOM, and the engine itself is imported on the first YouTube call instead of at startup
- Yandex downloads work for family members of a Plus subscription, where the account reports no Plus at all while Yandex serves whole tracks; only tracks the server marks as previews are refused
- A Yandex artist page lists the whole discography instead of the handful of albums brief-info returns
- Unavailable catalog rows are disabled and preview rows badged before anything is requested, and rate limits are honoured: no retry on a forbidden request, and `Retry-After` is respected by queries and the download manager
- The library view of an added remote album, artist or playlist links back to its catalog page

### Bug Fixes

- Search results from a source used the library's track menu and links - they are catalog rows now, the best result included
- Covers for catalog rows are fetched at the full rendition instead of a list thumbnail
- A liked catalog track no longer shows up twice in album listings next to its downloaded copy
